quote: Atlas Renewable Energy and Brazil’s National Bank for Economic and Social Development (BNDES) approved an approximately BRL 1 billion (about US$179 million) financing package for the construction of the Draco Solar Complex in Minas Gerais, Brazil.
note: Opened Atlas English press; BRL ~1bn BNDES / 505 MWac Draco / MG / COD early 2026 confirmed. CapEx USD via Fed H.10 Sep 25 2026 5.1921.
